goal: Build a pure Rust, side-effect-free TELE whisper classifier and context policy using the proven SummonScout phrase corpus, with explicit handling for Hyjal, Winterspring and Hydraxian/Azshara and no runtime TX wiring yet.
notes: Offline-safe foundation built while TELE-03 awaits real party runtime evidence. No socket writes or automatic actions. Ambiguous short signals such as +, 123, here, go and inv are contextual rather than globally actionable.
